svg.aria-label: Filter-guided neighbor work-group stealing: a GPM that finishes early steals not-yet-started work-groups from 1-2 hop neighbours, picking the group whose footprint overlaps data it already holds
svg.text: (a) Per-GPM busy time: static split vs. stealing
(b) Steal only from neighbors within 2 hops
T = GPM that finished early; shaded = within 2 hops
a far victim's WGs would pay 5–10 extra hops per remote access
(c) Which pending WG group to steal: footprint filters
Footprint filters are cuckoo filters, so stale pages can be deleted when a group's footprint changes. Without history,
fall back to the adjacent / same-group WGs. The thief's RRT is the same table that T18 uses for merging.
